intro: Paris rewards slow days: museums in the morning, a long lunch, a walk along the Seine. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: The Métro and RER cover the whole city; a single ticket is about €2.50 and weekly Navigo passes are good value.
Buses use the same tickets and are slower but scenic.
Taxis are metered with flat fares from the airports; Uber, Bolt and G7 apps work everywhere.
Driving and parking in Paris are hard; a car is only useful for day trips.
Central Paris is compact and very walkable; Vélib' bikes are everywhere.
RER C goes to Versailles; Disneyland is on RER A.

eiffel.name: Eiffel Tower
eiffel.price_text: ≈ EUR 15–30 by lift to the top; stairs cheaper. Check the day's price
eiffel.hours: Daily, roughly 09:30–23:00; longer in summer. Check on the day
eiffel.tip: Book a timed lift ticket online weeks ahead. The Trocadéro side gives the classic photo.

louvre.name: Louvre Museum
louvre.price_text: ≈ EUR 22 adult; under 18 free. Check on the day
louvre.hours: Closed Tuesday · open other days around 09:00–18:00, late Friday
louvre.tip: Enter via the Carrousel or Porte des Lions to skip the pyramid queue. Pick three rooms, not the whole museum.

orsay.name: Musée d'Orsay
orsay.price_text: ≈ EUR 16 adult; under 18 free. Check on the day
orsay.hours: Closed Monday · Tue–Sun around 09:30–18:00, late Thursday
orsay.tip: Head to the top floor first for the Impressionists and the clock-window view.

notredame.name: Notre-Dame de Paris
notredame.price_text: Free entry to the cathedral; towers may charge. Check on the day
notredame.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–19:00. Check on the day
notredame.tip: Go early to avoid the long free-entry line. The towers need a separate timed slot.

saintechapelle.name: Sainte-Chapelle
saintechapelle.price_text: ≈ EUR 13 adult; under 18 free. Check on the day
saintechapelle.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–19:00 in summer, shorter in winter
saintechapelle.tip: Come on a sunny late afternoon when light floods the upper stained glass.

arc.name: Arc de Triomphe
arc.price_text: ≈ EUR 16 adult to the roof; under 18 free. Check on the day
arc.tip: Use the underground passage from the Champs-Élysées side. Never cross the traffic circle.

champs.name: Champs-Élysées
champs.tip: Walk it once for the scale, then escape to the side streets for cheaper cafés.

sacrecoeur.name: Sacré-Cœur Basilica
sacrecoeur.price_text: Free entry to the basilica; dome climb costs a few euros
sacrecoeur.tip: Sit on the steps at sunset for the city view. Keep bags zipped; the area is busy with pickpockets.

montmartre.name: Montmartre
montmartre.tip: Skip the funicular and climb the side stairs. Explore west of the basilica for quiet lanes.

versailles.name: Palace of Versailles
versailles.price_text: ≈ EUR 21 palace; gardens mostly free. Check on the day
versailles.tip: Take the RER C train and arrive at opening. Book a timed slot; the palace is far from central Paris.

pompidou.name: Centre Pompidou
pompidou.price_text: ≈ EUR 15 adult. Check on the day
pompidou.tip: Ride the outdoor escalator for a free city view even without a ticket.

marais.name: Le Marais
marais.hours: Always open; shops closed Sunday partly
marais.tip: Walk Rue des Rosiers for falafel and the Place des Vosges for a picnic.

luxembourg.name: Luxembourg Gardens
luxembourg.price_text: Free; small fee for the playground
luxembourg.tip: Grab a chair by the pond and watch the model sailboats. Great picnic stop.

pantheon.name: Panthéon
pantheon.price_text: ≈ EUR 13 adult. Check on the day
pantheon.tip: Climb the dome for a close-up view over the Latin Quarter. Buy the combined dome ticket.

garnier.name: Palais Garnier
garnier.price_text: ≈ EUR 15 self-guided visit. Check on the day
garnier.hours: Daily, roughly 10:00–17:00; closed on show days partly
garnier.tip: See the grand staircase and the Chagall ceiling. Check whether the auditorium is open that day.

invalides.name: Les Invalides
invalides.price_text: ≈ EUR 16 adult for the Army Museum and Napoleon's tomb. Check on the day
invalides.tip: The golden dome and Napoleon's tomb are the highlights. Allow time for the Army Museum.

orangerie.name: Musée de l'Orangerie
orangerie.price_text: ≈ EUR 12.50 adult. Check on the day
orangerie.tip: Two oval rooms hold Monet's Water Lilies. Go early and sit in the middle.

rodin.name: Musée Rodin
rodin.price_text: ≈ EUR 14 adult; garden cheaper. Check on the day
rodin.tip: The sculpture garden is lovely and quieter than most museums. Bring a coffee.

seinecruise.name: Seine River Cruise
seinecruise.price_text: ≈ EUR 15–20 for a one-hour cruise. Check on the day
seinecruise.tip: Take a night cruise to see the lit monuments. Board near the Eiffel Tower or Pont Neuf.

catacombs.name: Catacombs of Paris
catacombs.price_text: ≈ EUR 29 adult with online booking. Check on the day
catacombs.tip: Book online; walk-up lines are long. It is cool and narrow down there, so wear a jacket.

montparnasse.name: Montparnasse Tower
montparnasse.price_text: ≈ EUR 19 adult to the rooftop. Check on the day
montparnasse.tip: Best view of the Eiffel Tower because the tower itself is in the skyline. Go at sunset.

disney.name: Disneyland Park
disney.price_text: ≈ EUR 62+ per day, price varies by date. Check on the day
disney.tip: Take RER A to Marne-la-Vallée–Chessy. Buy dated tickets online and arrive at opening.

tuileries.name: Tuileries Garden
tuileries.tip: Walk from the Louvre to Place de la Concorde. Green chairs by the ponds are free to use.

pere.name: Père Lachaise Cemetery
pere.tip: Pick up a free map at the gate. Look for Chopin, Wilde and Morrison, then wander.

aligre.name: Marché d'Aligre
aligre.price_text: Free to browse; food priced per item
aligre.tip: Covered market plus a lively street market. Come before noon for the best produce.

trocadero.name: Trocadéro viewpoint
trocadero.tip: The best free Eiffel Tower photo spot. Come at sunrise for fewer crowds.

foodtour.name: Latin Quarter food walk
foodtour.price_text: ≈ EUR 60–90 per person with tastings. Check on the day
foodtour.hours: Tours usually run late morning and early evening
foodtour.tip: Book a small-group walk for cheese, bread and wine. Confirm tastings are included in the price.

canal.name: Canal Saint-Martin walk
canal.tip: Stroll the iron footbridges and stop for coffee on Rue de Marseille. Quiet on weekday mornings.

boulangerie.name: Neighbourhood bakery breakfast
boulangerie.price_text: ≈ EUR 5–10 for a croissant and coffee
boulangerie.hours: Most bakeries open early morning to evening
boulangerie.tip: Eat standing at the counter or take away; sitting at a table costs more.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: The Louvre, Notre-Dame and the old streets of Le Marais.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Markets, bakeries and long bistro lunches.

styles.label: Romance
styles.blurb: Seine walks, candlelit dinners and Montmartre at dusk.

stays.why: Central and walkable. Close to Notre-Dame, the Pompidou and good cheap food. Lively at night.
Classic Paris feel by the river. Good for cafés, bookshops and the Luxembourg Gardens.
Closest to the Louvre, the Tuileries and big department stores. Best metro links for short trips.
Quieter and often cheaper. Village feel around Sacré-Cœur, but longer rides to the centre.

food: Try a basic bistro lunch: many places do a fixed 'formule' of two or three courses for about €18–28.
Buy picnic food at a street market or bakery: baguette, cheese and fruit for under €10.
Order the plat du jour at lunch. It is usually cheaper than the same dish at dinner.
Tap water is free and safe. Ask for 'une carafe d'eau' instead of bottled water.
Book popular dinner spots a few days ahead. Many small places are closed one or two weekdays; check on the day.
more_time: Swap a city day for Versailles: take RER C, then walk the palace and gardens. Allow a full day.
Travelling with kids? Swap a museum morning for Disneyland on RER A. Book tickets ahead.
Want a slower day? Ride a Vélib' bike along the Seine and stop at a market for lunch.
